# Planet textures

- `earth-blue-marble.jpg`, `earth-night.jpg`, `earth-topology.png`, `earth-water.png`
  — from the [three-globe](https://github.com/vasturiano/three-globe) examples
  (MIT, © Vasco Asturiano); imagery from NASA Blue Marble / Black Marble (public domain).
- `clouds.png`, `moon.jpg`, `lunar_bumpmap.jpg` — from the
  [globe.gl](https://github.com/vasturiano/globe.gl) examples (MIT);
  cloud and lunar imagery from NASA (public domain). Resized.

Mars, Mercury and Venus are recoloured from these in `space/planets.js`.
